Relieves toxicity and clears Heart Fire. With Huang Qin and Zhi Zi, clears Heat and assists Niu Huang and Xi Jiao to clear Pericardium Heat.

Clears Heat and eliminates irritability.
Dislodges Phlegm, relieves toxicity and Helps open Orifices and drain turbid Phlegm. With Yu Jin , for excessive Phlegm obstruction accompanying childhood convulsions.

Clears the Heart and Pericardium.

With Zhen Zhu and Jin Bo , sedates the Heart, calms the Shen and clears Heat from the Heart and Liver channels.
Calms the Shen , sedates the Heart, clears Heat and removes toxins. With Feng Mi , for patients who are easily frightened.

ingredients.actions: Tonifies Heart Qi and calms the Spirit. With Fu Ling, Fu Shen Shi Chang Pu and Yuan Zhi, for confusion and forgetfulness.
Nourishes the Heart and calms the Shen .
Quiets the Heart, calms the Spirit and soothes the nerves. With Shi Chang Pu and Yuan Zhi, for insomnia and palpitations due to Spleen and Heart Insufficiency or Phlegm Obstructing the Heart.

Calms the Spirit and sedates the Heart and clears the channel joining the Heart and Kidney . With Chao Suan Zao Ren, balances the contrasting, introverted and dispersing, extroverted manifestations of Spirit to ensure the proper balance of openness and sobriety. With Fu Shen and Chao Suan Zao Ren, for irritability, disorientation, palpitations, anxiety, and insomnia due to Heart Blood Deficiency or Qi Stagnation. With Ren Shen, Fu Ling and Shi Chang Pu, calms the spirit.

Settles anxiety, calms the Spirit, calms the Liver and anchors and preserves Floating Yang and is especially effective for palpitations with anxiety, insomnia, dream-disturbed sleep, convulsions and delirium. With Zhu Sha, as a sedative and tranquilizer. With Shi Chang Pu and Yuan Zhi, for restless Shen.

Opens the Orifices, vaporizes Phlegm, removes filth, calms the Spirit and disperses Wind. With Yuan Zhi and Fu Ling, for forgetfulness, tinnitus, and impaired hearing. With Fu Shen, for forgetfulness and dulled senses.
Nourishes the Heart, astringes the Liver, calms the Spirit, facilitates sleep and treats irritable thirst and sweating from Deficiency.

Heavily settles and calms the Spirit, calms the Liver, benefits the Yin and anchors Floating Yang. With Ye Jiao Teng, for insomnia.

ingredients.actions: Moistens and nourishes the Lungs and clears Heat. With Shu Di Huang, for palpitations, irritability, insomnia, and dark, scanty urine due to lingering Heat. With Sheng Di Huang and Shu Di Huang , nourishes and moistens the Lungs and Kidneys. With Sheng Di Huang, Shu Di Huang and Xuan Shen, for cough with Blood-streaked sputum, hot palms and soles and night sweats from Lung and Kidney Yin Deficiency. With Mai Men Dong, Xuan Shen and Chuan Bei Mu , for chronic dry cough and sore throat due to Lung Yin Deficiency.

Tonifies the Kidneys, nourishes Yin , generates fluids, i ncreases saliva, cools the Blood and stops bleeding. With Xuan Shen , for dry throat, irritability, a red tongue and a thready, rapid pulse due to Yin Deficiency with Fire Flaring. With Xuan Shen and Mai Men Dong, for dry throat, irritability, a red tongue, and a fast thready pulse due to Devastated Yin with Blazing Fire, excessive thirst, irritability, and a scarlet tongue due to Ying Stage Heat, swelling of the throat and lymph nodes and constipation due to Excess Heat with Yin Deficiency. With Bai Shao, for Blood Deficiency Heat.
Tonifies Liver and Kidney Yin . With Sheng Di Huang, treats Yin Deficiency with Fire Flaring.

Moistens the Lungs, stops cough and nourishes Yin especially of the Upper Jiao. With Xuan Shen , nourishes Yin and clears Heat. With Xuan Shen, Jie Geng and Gan Cao, for itchy, dry throat, thirst and a nonproductive cough due to Lung Yin Deficiency. With Sheng Di Huang, for hematemesis or epistaxis due to Yin Deficiency with Excess Heat.
Clears Heat, cools the Blood and nourishes Yin . With Bai He, for Yin Deficiency with Lung Dryness and a dry cough. With Jie Geng and Gan Cao, for a sore throat with Dryness and pain.
Moistens the Lungs, transforms Phlegm, stops cough and clears Heat. With Xuan Shen , clears Heat.

Moves Lung Qi , expels Phlegm and stops cough especially with Chuan Bei Mu . With Gan Cao, disseminates Lung Qi, expels Phlegm, resolves toxicity, and expels pus for productive cough with hoarseness, pain and swelling of the throat due to Wind-Heat.
Nourishes and invigorates the Blood. With Bai Shao , nourishes Yin Blood and protects the Lungs against Liver attack. With Shu Di Huang, for Heat symptoms due to Yin Deficiency and Devastated Blood.
Nourishes Blood and astringes Yin . With Dang Gui, Shu Di Huang and Mai Men Dong, for tinnitus, dizziness, blurred vision, numbness of the extremities, and muscle spasms due to Liver Yin Deficiency.
Moistens the Lungs, clears Heat, stops cough and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs. With Jie Geng , benefits the throat.

ingredients.actions: Moistens and nourishes the Lungs and clears Heat. With Shu Di Huang, for palpitations, irritability, insomnia, and dark, scanty urine due to lingering Heat. With Sheng Di Huang and Shu Di Huang , nourishes and moistens the Lungs and Kidneys. With Sheng Di Huang, Shu Di Huang and Xuan Shen, for cough with Blood-streaked sputum, hot palms and soles and night sweats from Lung and Kidney Yin Deficiency. With Mai Men Dong, Xuan Shen and Chuan Bei Mu , for chronic dry cough and sore throat due to Lung Yin Deficiency.

Tonifies the Kidneys, nourishes Yin , generates fluids, i ncreases saliva, cools the Blood and stops bleeding. With Xuan Shen , for dry throat, irritability, a red tongue and a thready, rapid pulse due to Yin Deficiency with Fire Flaring. With Xuan Shen and Mai Men Dong, for dry throat, irritability, a red tongue, and a fast thready pulse due to Devastated Yin with Blazing Fire, excessive thirst, irritability, and a scarlet tongue due to Ying Stage Heat, swelling of the throat and lymph nodes and constipation due to Excess Heat with Yin Deficiency. With Bai Shao, for Blood Deficiency Heat.
Tonifies Liver and Kidney Yin . With Sheng Di Huang, treats Yin Deficiency with Fire Flaring.

Moistens the Lungs, stops cough and nourishes Yin especially of the Upper Jiao. With Xuan Shen , nourishes Yin and clears Heat. With Xuan Shen, Jie Geng and Gan Cao, for itchy, dry throat, thirst and a nonproductive cough due to Lung Yin Deficiency. With Sheng Di Huang, for hematemesis or epistaxis due to Yin Deficiency with Excess Heat.
Clears Heat, cools the Blood and nourishes Yin . With Bai He, for Yin Deficiency with Lung Dryness and a dry cough. With Jie Geng and Gan Cao, for a sore throat with Dryness and pain.
Moistens the Lungs, transforms Phlegm, stops cough and clears Heat. With Xuan Shen , clears Heat.

Moves Lung Qi , expels Phlegm and stops cough especially with Chuan Bei Mu . With Gan Cao, disseminates Lung Qi, expels Phlegm, resolves toxicity, and expels pus for productive cough with hoarseness, pain and swelling of the throat due to Wind-Heat.
Nourishes and invigorates the Blood. With Bai Shao , nourishes Yin Blood and protects the Lungs against Liver attack. With Shu Di Huang, for Heat symptoms due to Yin Deficiency and Devastated Blood.
Nourishes Blood and astringes Yin . With Dang Gui, Shu Di Huang and Mai Men Dong, for tinnitus, dizziness, blurred vision, numbness of the extremities, and muscle spasms due to Liver Yin Deficiency.
Moistens the Lungs, clears Heat, stops cough and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs. With Jie Geng , benefits the throat.

syndromes: Lung and Kidney Yin Deficiency with Fire Flaring
contraindicationsAndInteractions: Contraindicated for those with cough due to Excess conditions.
Use caution or those with Spleen Deficiency.
Use caution or those with Food Stagnation.

Alleviates pain, and moderates and harmonizes the properties of the other herbs.
Tonifies Yang , tonifies Qi , stops restlessness, stops thirst and generates fluids.

ingredients.actions: Clears Heat, drains Fire. With Zhi Mu , clears Heat from the Lungs and Stomach to alleviate irritability, moisten Dryness, and enrich Yin .
(May substitute for Shi Gao .)
Clears Heat from the Qi Stage, Lung and Stomach, nourishes Yin , moistens Dryness and generates fluids.

Tonifies the Spleen and augments Qi and Moderates and harmonizes the properties of other herbs. With Geng Mi, benefits the Stomach, protects fluids and prevents the extremely cold properties of the other herbs from injuring the Middle Jiao.
(May substitute for Zhi Gan Cao for its ability to generate fluids and quench thirst.)
Tonifies Yang, tonifies Qi , stops restlessness, generates fluids and stops thirst .

clinicalManifestations: Severe thirst with a strong desire to drink
May be sensitive to Cold in the upper back
P:Flooding and forceful or Large and forceless or Slippery and rapid
contraindicationsAndInteractions: Contraindicated for those with fever due to Spleen and Stomach Yin Deficiency manifesting as fever, spontaneous sweat, extreme fatigue, aversion to Wind, and a Deficiency floating pulse

Contraindicated for those with True Cold and False Heat manifesting fever with a desire for warmth, no desire to drink, agitated movements of the limbs in an otherwise subdued patient and flooding, weak pulse.
Contraindicated for those with Yang Ming Fu.
Use caution for those with a floating, wiry and thin pulse.
Use caution for those with a submerged pulse.
Use caution for those with absence of thirst.
Use caution for those with absence of sweating.

alsoKnownAs: Pinellia and Gastrodia Combination Decoction of Pinellia, White Atractylodes and Gastrodia Ban Xia Tian Ma Bai Zhu Tang

ingredients.actions: Transforms Phlegm, dries Dampness, descends Rebellious Qi and treats nausea and vomiting. With Chen Pi, for epigastric and abdominal distention or pain due to disharmony of the Stomach Qi. With Fu Ling, expels Phlegm and stops nausea and vomiting, hiccups, coughs with clear, profuse Phlegm and loose and watery stools. With Tian Ma, Bai Zhu and Fu Ling, for Phlegm-Dampness rising upward and combining with uprising Internal Wind with symptoms of headache, dizziness, focal distention, a stifling sensation in the chest and diaphragm, a greasy white tongue and wiry and slippery pulse.

Extinguishes Wind, subdues Rising Liver Yang , alleviates pain, disperses Wind-Damp Bi and effectively treats headache, dizziness and vertigo. With Zhi Ban Xia, Bai Zhu and Chen Pi, for headaches and dizziness from Wind-Phlegm. With Zhi Ban Xia, Bai Zhu and Fu Ling, for a heavy feeling and a congested headache.

Strengthens the Spleen, dries Dampness and reinforces Ban Xia and Tian Ma in treating Phlegm. With Tian Ma and Fu Ling, for Phlegm due to Spleen Dampness with Internal Liver Wind. With Fu Ling and Gan Cao, for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiencies. With Zhi Ban Xia, Tian Ma, Fu Ling and Chen Pi, for dizziness and vertigo due to accumulation of Phlegm and Liver Wind.

Is more drying and aromatic than Chen Pi, but less effective at harmonizing the Middle and regulating the Spleen and Stomach. It is primarily used for vomiting and belching and for treating Phlegm-Damp coughs.

( Regulates Qi and transforms Phlegm. May substitute for Ju Hong .) (With Sheng Jiang, for vomiting and hiccups due to Disharmony of the Stomach Qi and Cold-Dampness Obstructing the Middle with nausea and hiccup. (With Zhi Ban Xia , for a stifling sensation in the chest and cough with excessive white, viscous sputum due to Phlegm-Damp Obstruction.) (With Bai Zhu, for anorexia and other symptoms of Damp-Obstruction due to Spleen Deficiency.) (With Zhi Ban Xia and Fu Ling, for cough due to accumulation of Dampness and Phlegm.)

Leaches out Dampness, strengthens the Spleen and assists in Transforming Phlegm. With Bai Zhu, strengthens the Spleen and resolves Dampness. With Zhi Ban Xia and Chen Pi , for nausea, vomiting, chest fullness and distention and anorexia due to congested fluids. With Zhi Ban Xia, Chen Pi and Sheng Jiang, for congested fluids in the Stomach causing nausea and vomiting. With Bai Zhu and Tian Ma, for Phlegm accumulation with vertigo.
Tonifies the Spleen and augments Qi , resolves Phlegm , and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs .

Warms the Middle, s tops vomiting , warms the Lungs, stops cough and reduces the toxicity of other herbs . With Da Zao , harmonizes the Spleen and Stomach. With Zhi Ban Xia, for vomiting due to many causes including Stomach Cold and productive cough due to Phlegm-Dampness.
Tonifies the Spleen and Stomach and augments Qi and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs. With Sheng Jiang, prevents Phlegm accumulation.

alsoKnownAs: Pinellia and Gastrodia Combination Decoction of Pinellia, White Atractylodes and Gastrodia Ban Xia Tian Ma Bai Zhu Tang

ingredients.actions: Transforms Phlegm, dries Dampness, descends Rebellious Qi and treats nausea and vomiting. With Chen Pi, for epigastric and abdominal distention or pain due to disharmony of the Stomach Qi. With Fu Ling, expels Phlegm and stops nausea and vomiting, hiccups, coughs with clear, profuse Phlegm and loose and watery stools. With Tian Ma, Bai Zhu and Fu Ling, for Phlegm-Dampness rising upward and combining with uprising Internal Wind with symptoms of headache, dizziness, focal distention, a stifling sensation in the chest and diaphragm, a greasy white tongue and wiry and slippery pulse.

Extinguishes Wind, subdues Rising Liver Yang , alleviates pain, disperses Wind-Damp Bi and effectively treats headache, dizziness and vertigo. With Zhi Ban Xia, Bai Zhu and Chen Pi, for headaches and dizziness from Wind-Phlegm. With Zhi Ban Xia, Bai Zhu and Fu Ling, for a heavy feeling and a congested headache.

Strengthens the Spleen, dries Dampness and reinforces Ban Xia and Tian Ma in treating Phlegm. With Tian Ma and Fu Ling, for Phlegm due to Spleen Dampness with Internal Liver Wind. With Fu Ling and Gan Cao, for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiencies. With Zhi Ban Xia, Tian Ma, Fu Ling and Chen Pi, for dizziness and vertigo due to accumulation of Phlegm and Liver Wind.

Is more drying and aromatic than Chen Pi, but less effective at harmonizing the Middle and regulating the Spleen and Stomach. It is primarily used for vomiting and belching and for treating Phlegm-Damp coughs.

( Regulates Qi and transforms Phlegm. May substitute for Ju Hong .) (With Sheng Jiang, for vomiting and hiccups due to Disharmony of the Stomach Qi and Cold-Dampness Obstructing the Middle with nausea and hiccup. (With Zhi Ban Xia , for a stifling sensation in the chest and cough with excessive white, viscous sputum due to Phlegm-Damp Obstruction.) (With Bai Zhu, for anorexia and other symptoms of Damp-Obstruction due to Spleen Deficiency.) (With Zhi Ban Xia and Fu Ling, for cough due to accumulation of Dampness and Phlegm.)

Leaches out Dampness, strengthens the Spleen and assists in Transforming Phlegm. With Bai Zhu, strengthens the Spleen and resolves Dampness. With Zhi Ban Xia and Chen Pi , for nausea, vomiting, chest fullness and distention and anorexia due to congested fluids. With Zhi Ban Xia, Chen Pi and Sheng Jiang, for congested fluids in the Stomach causing nausea and vomiting. With Bai Zhu and Tian Ma, for Phlegm accumulation with vertigo.
Tonifies the Spleen and augments Qi , resolves Phlegm , and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs .

Warms the Middle, s tops vomiting , warms the Lungs, stops cough and reduces the toxicity of other herbs . With Da Zao , harmonizes the Spleen and Stomach. With Zhi Ban Xia, for vomiting due to many causes including Stomach Cold and productive cough due to Phlegm-Dampness.
Tonifies the Spleen and Stomach and augments Qi and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs. With Sheng Jiang, prevents Phlegm accumulation.

Contraindicated for those with Kidney and Liver Yin Deficiencies.

ingredients.actions: Reduces all types of Food Stagnation especially meat and fatty foods. With Shen Qu, for general indigestion and Food Stagnation. With Lai Fu Zi and Shen Qu , reduces stagnation and accumulation caused by overindulgence in food and drink of all types. With Mai Ya and Shen Qu, for abdominal distention, belching, diarrhea and anorexia due to Food Stagnation and childhood nutritional impairment due to improper breast feeding.
Reduces Food Stagnation, promotes digestion, reduces stagnant alcohol, moves Qi and h armonizes the Stomach .

Descends Qi and reduces accumulation of Phlegm from stagnant grains. With Shan Zha, Shen Qu and Chen Pi, for abdominal distention, borborygmus, belching and acid regurgitation due to stagnation in ST or Intestines. With Zhi Ban Xia , for distention and vomiting due to Food Stagnation.

Regulates Qi , adjusts the Middle, r elieves the diaphragm, dries Dampness, t ransforms Phlegm and descends Qi . With Zhi Ban Xia , moves Qi and transforms stagnation to harmonize the Stomach and stop nausea and vomiting.

Descends Qi , transforms Phlegm, harmonizes the Stomach and reduces distention. With Chen Pi, for Stomach Qi Disharmony with epigastric and abdominal distention or pain. With Fu Ling, expels Phlegm and stops nausea and vomiting, hiccups, coughs with clear, profuse Phlegm and loose and watery stools, treats Phlegm, Thin Mucus and turbid Dampness and prevents turbid Phlegm and Dampness from disturbing the Heart with dizziness, palpitations and insomnia.

Strengthens the Spleen, drains Dampness, harmonizes the Middle Jiao and transforms Phlegm. With Zhi Ban Xia , expels Phlegm and stops nausea and vomiting. With Zhi Ban Xia and Chen Pi, for nausea, vomiting, chest fullness and distention, and anorexia due to congested fluids.
Clears Heat due to Stagnation.
(May be added to reduce stagnation from grains.)

contraindicationsAndInteractions: Contraindicated for those with Spleen Deficiency.

ingredients.actions: Promotes urination, unblocks painful urinary dysfunction, clears Damp obstruction and drains Heart Heat through the Small Intestine . With Hua Shi, Che Qian Zi and Zhi Zi, for painful urinary dribbling due to Damp-Heat in the Bladder. With Che Qian Zi, for Heart Fire Transferring to the Small Intestine channel causing edema and painful urinary dysfunction.

Drains Heat from the Bladder, aids expulsion of stones, expels Damp-Heat and stops bleeding due to Heat. With Mu Tong, for Heat Lin. With Zhi Zi and Mu Tong, for Lin Syndrome with hot, painful urinary dribbling and scanty, dark, painful urination. With Che Qian Zi, Qu Mai and Bian Xu , clears Damp-Heat by promoting urination. With Mu Tong, Che Qian Zi and Zhi Zi, for Damp-Heat dysuria with pain and cloudy urine.
Promotes urination and clears Heat. With Mu Tong and Hua Shi, for Lin Syndrome.

Promotes urination, drains Damp-Heat from the Bladder and unblocks painful urinary dysfunction. With Hua Shi and Mu Tong, for Lin Syndrome. With Zhi Zi, for Lower Jiao Damp-Heat with burning, painful, dribbling urination. With Che Qian Zi and Hua Shi, for Heat dysuria ( Re Lin) with burning and pain during urination.

Promotes urination, drains Damp-Heat from the Bladder and eliminates painful urination. With Qu Mai and Che Qian Zi , for Damp-Heat in Lower Jiao or Stone Lin with urinary discomfort. With Qu Mai, for painful urinary dysfunction. With Mu Tong, Che Qian Zi, Zhi Zi and Hua Shi, for Damp-Heat dysuria (Shi-Re Lin).

Drains Heat from the three Jiaos through the urine and stops bleeding. With Hua Shi, for painful urinary dysfunction due to Damp-Heat in the Bladder. With Hua Shi, Bian Xu and Che Qian Zi, for urinary tract infection.

Drains Damp-Heat and clears Heat through the stool. With Che Qian Zi and Bian Xu , for hot, painful urinary dysfunction. With Che Qian Zi, Mu Tong and Zhi Zi, for hot, painful urinary dysfunction. With Zhi Zi, for constipation.

Promotes urination, leaches out Dampness, unblocks painful urinary dysfunction, clears Heat from the Heart channel by directing Fire downward and calms the Spirit. With Hua Shi, for Damp-Heat in the Heart, Lung and Bladder channels causing incomplete, painful urination. With Mu Tong, for difficult, scanty and burning associated with Heart channel Heat shifting to the Large Intestine or Heat clumping in the Bladder or Damp-Heat lodging in the Lower Jiao.
Harmonizes, relieves abdominal pain, clears Heat and relieves Fire toxicity. With Hua Shi, relieves irritability.
(Strengthens the diuretic action of the formula.)

With Bai Zhu, Fu Ling and Zhi Gan Cao, for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiency with Dampness, anorexia, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal distention and fatigue. With Shu Di Huang, Bai Zhu, Fu Ling and Bai Shao, for Qi and Blood Deficiency.

With Fu Ling and Zhi Gan Cao, for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiency. With Fu Ling and Sheng Jiang, for edema with Kidney Yang Deficiency. Dries Dampness and strengthens the Spleen. With Ren Shen and Bai Zhu, for weak and deficient Spleen with fatigue, anorexia and loose stools.
Augments Qi , ,warms and strengthens the Middle Jiao and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs. With Ren Shen, for anorexia, fatigue and loose stools due to Spleen Deficiency.

Strengthens the Liver and Kidneys, and nourishes the Yin of the Blood . With Dang Gui, for Blood Deficiency marked by dizziness, palpitations, insomnia and menstrual dysfunction. With Bai Shao, Dang Gui and Chuan Xiong, for anemia. With Ren Shen, Bai Zhu, Fu Ling, Dang Gui and Bai Shao, for anemia with fatigue and weakness.

Tonifies Blood and preserves Yin . With Shu Di Huang, strongly tonifies Liver Blood. With Shu Di Huang and Dang Gui, for dizziness, blurred vision, and dysmenorrhea due to Blood Deficiency or Stasis. With Dang Gui, nourishes Yin and Blood.

Tonifies and invigorates the Blood, moistens the Intestines and regulates the relationship between the Liver and Kidneys. With Bai Shao, regulates and harmonizes Qi and Blood and treats Blood Deficiency Heat. With Bai Shao, Shu Di Huang and Chuan Xiong, for menstrual irregularity, amenorrhea, and dysmenorrhea due to Blood Deficiency or Blood Stasis. With Shu Di Huang, for Heat symptoms due to Yin Deficiency and Devastated Blood. With Bai Shao and Fu Ling, for diarrhea during pregnancy with mild abdominal pain. With Chuan Xiong, harmonizes, nourishes and invigorates the Blood and disperses Blood Stasis. With Ren Shen, Bai Zhu, Shu Di Huang and Bai Shao, for general menstrual disorders with fatigue and weakness due to Qi and Blood Deficiency.

Invigorates the Blood, activates Qi , releases constraint and alleviates pain. With Dang Gui, harmonizes, nourishes and invigorates the Blood and disperses Blood Stasis for Blood Deficiency causing menstrual problems including dysmenorrhea, scanty menses, and amenorrhea. With Dang Gui, Shu Di Huang and Bai Shao, for headache from Blood Deficiency.

Regulates the Spleen and Stomach. With Da Zao , alleviates epigastric pain, nausea, and vomiting by strengthening the Spleen, harmonizes the Ying and Wei , Nourishes the Blood, prevents injury from harsh Blood movers and assists the movement of Qi .

Tonifies the Spleen and Stomach, augments Qi, nourishes the Blood, c alms the Spirit and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs . With Ren Shen, Bai Shao and Fu Ling, for weakness and lassitude due to Spleen and Stomach Deficiency. With Sheng Jiang, enhances the effects of other Qi and Blood tonifying herbs by facilitating their digestion and absorption.

bu-zhong-yi-qi-tang-9680ecb6.englishName: Tonify the Middle and Augment the Qi Decoction
alsoKnownAs: Ginseng and Astragalus Combination Decoction for Reinforcing the Center and Replenishing Qi Interior Nourishing and Qi Increasing Decoction Middle-Reinforcing and Qi- Benefiting Decoction

ingredients.actions: Strongly tonifies Qi , strengthens the Spleen and raises Spleen Yang . With Ren Shen , for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia and spontaneous perspiration. With Bai Zhu , for Spleen Qi Deficiency with weakness, lassitude and loose stools.
Strongly tonifies Qi , reinforces Yang and harmonizes the Middle Jiao . With Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , assists Huang Qi in strengthening Qi.
(Substitutes for Ren Shen .)
Strengthens the Spleen and dries Dampness.
Tonifies the Spleen and harmonizes.
Tonifies the Qi of the Blood and invigorates and harmonizes the Blood. With Huang Qi, Ren Shen, Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , augments Qi by Invigorating Blood.
Regulates Qi , tonifies the Spleen, assists raising Qi , aids digestion of tonics and prevents bloating which may accompany Qi tonics.
Raises Yang , raises sunken Qi and guides other herbs upwards. With Chai Hu and Huang Qi , raises Sunken Yang .
Raises Yang Qi and relieves Stagnation.
(Variation of the formula) With Da Zao , harmonizes and protects the Spleen and Stomach.)
(Variation of the formula )

bu-zhong-yi-qi-tang-32ee1750.englishName: Tonify the Middle and Augment the Qi Decoction
alsoKnownAs: Ginseng and Astragalus Combination Decoction for Reinforcing the Center and Replenishing Qi Interior Nourishing and Qi Increasing Decoction Middle-Reinforcing and Qi- Benefiting Decoction

ingredients.actions: Strongly tonifies Qi , strengthens the Spleen and raises Spleen Yang . With Ren Shen , for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia and spontaneous perspiration. With Bai Zhu , for Spleen Qi Deficiency with weakness, lassitude and loose stools.
Strongly tonifies Qi , reinforces Yang and harmonizes the Middle Jiao . With Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , assists Huang Qi in strengthening Qi.
(Substitutes for Ren Shen .)
Strengthens the Spleen and dries Dampness.
Tonifies the Spleen and harmonizes.
Tonifies the Qi of the Blood and invigorates and harmonizes the Blood. With Huang Qi, Ren Shen, Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , augments Qi by Invigorating Blood.
Regulates Qi , tonifies the Spleen, assists raising Qi , aids digestion of tonics and prevents bloating which may accompany Qi tonics.
Raises Yang , raises sunken Qi and guides other herbs upwards. With Chai Hu and Huang Qi , raises Sunken Yang .
Raises Yang Qi and relieves Stagnation.
(Variation of the formula) With Da Zao , harmonizes and protects the Spleen and Stomach.)
(Variation of the formula )

bu-zhong-yi-qi-tang-bb85ce9b.englishName: Tonify the Middle and Augment the Qi Decoction
alsoKnownAs: Ginseng and Astragalus Combination Decoction for Reinforcing the Center and Replenishing Qi Interior Nourishing and Qi Increasing Decoction Middle-Reinforcing and Qi- Benefiting Decoction

ingredients.actions: Strongly tonifies Qi , strengthens the Spleen and raises Spleen Yang . With Ren Shen , for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia and spontaneous perspiration. With Bai Zhu , for Spleen Qi Deficiency with weakness, lassitude and loose stools.
Strongly tonifies Qi , reinforces Yang and harmonizes the Middle Jiao . With Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , assists Huang Qi in strengthening Qi.
(Substitutes for Ren Shen .)
Strengthens the Spleen and dries Dampness.
Tonifies the Spleen and harmonizes.
Tonifies the Qi of the Blood and invigorates and harmonizes the Blood. With Huang Qi, Ren Shen, Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , augments Qi by Invigorating Blood.
Regulates Qi , tonifies the Spleen, assists raising Qi , aids digestion of tonics and prevents bloating which may accompany Qi tonics.
Raises Yang , raises sunken Qi and guides other herbs upwards. With Chai Hu and Huang Qi , raises Sunken Yang .
Raises Yang Qi and relieves Stagnation.
(Variation of the formula) With Da Zao , harmonizes and protects the Spleen and Stomach.)
(Variation of the formula )

bu-zhong-yi-qi-tang-9d91a32d.englishName: Tonify the Middle and Augment the Qi Decoction
alsoKnownAs: Ginseng and Astragalus Combination Decoction for Reinforcing the Center and Replenishing Qi Interior Nourishing and Qi Increasing Decoction Middle-Reinforcing and Qi- Benefiting Decoction

ingredients.actions: Strongly tonifies Qi , strengthens the Spleen and raises Spleen Yang . With Ren Shen , for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia and spontaneous perspiration. With Bai Zhu , for Spleen Qi Deficiency with weakness, lassitude and loose stools.
Strongly tonifies Qi , reinforces Yang and harmonizes the Middle Jiao . With Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , assists Huang Qi in strengthening Qi.
(Substitutes for Ren Shen .)
Strengthens the Spleen and dries Dampness.
Tonifies the Spleen and harmonizes.
Tonifies the Qi of the Blood and invigorates and harmonizes the Blood. With Huang Qi, Ren Shen, Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , augments Qi by Invigorating Blood.
Regulates Qi , tonifies the Spleen, assists raising Qi , aids digestion of tonics and prevents bloating which may accompany Qi tonics.
Raises Yang , raises sunken Qi and guides other herbs upwards. With Chai Hu and Huang Qi , raises Sunken Yang .
Raises Yang Qi and relieves Stagnation.
(Variation of the formula) With Da Zao , harmonizes and protects the Spleen and Stomach.)
(Variation of the formula )

alsoKnownAs: Ginseng and Astragalus Combination Decoction for Reinforcing the Center and Replenishing Qi Interior Nourishing and Qi Increasing Decoction Middle-Reinforcing and Qi- Benefiting Decoction

ingredients.actions: Strongly tonifies Qi , strengthens the Spleen and raises Spleen Yang . With Ren Shen , for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia and spontaneous perspiration. With Bai Zhu , for Spleen Qi Deficiency with weakness, lassitude and loose stools.
Strongly tonifies Qi , reinforces Yang and harmonizes the Middle Jiao . With Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , assists Huang Qi in strengthening Qi.
(Substitutes for Ren Shen .)
Strengthens the Spleen and dries Dampness.
Tonifies the Spleen and harmonizes.
Tonifies the Qi of the Blood and invigorates and harmonizes the Blood. With Huang Qi, Ren Shen, Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , augments Qi by Invigorating Blood.
Regulates Qi , tonifies the Spleen, assists raising Qi , aids digestion of tonics and prevents bloating which may accompany Qi tonics.
Raises Yang , raises sunken Qi and guides other herbs upwards. With Chai Hu and Huang Qi , raises Sunken Yang .
Raises Yang Qi and relieves Stagnation.
(Variation of the formula) With Da Zao , harmonizes and protects the Spleen and Stomach.)
(Variation of the formula )

ingredients.actions: Resolves Shao Yang disorders and reduces fever (harmonizes the Exterior and Interior). With Huang Qin clears Liver and Gallbladder Heat. With Zhi Shi , strongly moves Qi . With Huang Qin and Zhi Ban Xia, for Shao Yang disorders with alternating chills and fever and a sensation of fullness in the hypochondria and chest. With Bai Shao, for Liver Blood Deficiency with Liver Qi Stagnation and vertigo, dizziness, thoracic and costal pain, and menstrual irregularity due to Liver Qi Stagnation.

Clears Heat, dries Dampness, drains Fire, detoxifies, cools the Blood, stops bleeding and calms ascending Liver Yang. With Bai Shao, for dysenteric disorders with abdominal pain due to Heat entering the Interior. With Da Huang, for constipation.

Strongly moves Qi , breaks up Qi Stagnation and reduces distension and fullness in the chest and abdomen . With Da Huang , drains Heat retained in the interior, constipation and abdominal swelling due to Food Stagnation and Qi Stag-nation and diarrhea, dysentery, and abdominal pain due to Damp-Heat. With Da Huang and Huang Qin, for dysenteric diarrhea with tenesmus due to Damp-Heat, especially due to Food Stagnation transforming into Damp-Heat. With Chai Hu, Huang Qin and Zhi Ban Xia, for cholecystitis.
Drains Stomach and Gallbladder Heat through the stool, transforms Blood Stasis, and facilitates the flow of bile.

Nourishes the Blood, softens the Liver and treats abdominal pain and distension. With Zhi Shi and Da Huang , treats pain in the abdomen due to Excess. With Chai Hu, for flank pain due to Liver Qi Stagnation.
Harmonizes the Middle Jiao and descends rebellious Stomach Qi . With Sheng Jiang, stops vomiting.

Warms the Middle, s tops vomiting, reduces the toxicity of other herbs and seafood and adjusts the Ying and Wei . With Da Zao , alleviates epigastric pain, nausea, and vomiting by strengthening the Spleen, protects Stomach Qi and reduces irritation of the gastrointestinal tract by other herbs.

Helps Bai Shao soften the Liver, reduces abdominal spasms, protects the Yin from injury by pathogenic Heat and protects against the harsh properties of Da Huang and Zhi Shi . With Sheng Jiang , mildly regulates the Ying and Wei and aids the release of pathogens.

formulaActions: Harmonizes and Disperses the Shao Yang
clinicalManifestations: Fullness in the chest and hypochondrium (with or without pain)
Hard focal distension in the epigastrium
Fullness and pain in the epigastrium
Burning diarrhea or no bowel movement
Constipation or discharge of fluids rectally
C: Yellow or Thick and yellow
P: Wiry and forceful or Wiry tight and forceful
contraindicationsAndInteractions: Contraindicated for those with Spleen and Stomach Deficiencies.

ingredients.actions: Cools Heart Fire, nourishes Yin , cools Blood and generates Fluids.

Clears Heat from the Heart channel and clears Heat and promotes urination through the Small Intestine channel. With Dan Zhu Ye and Sheng Di Huang , for mouth ulcers, burning throat pain, irritability and insomnia due to Heart Fire.

Alleviates irritability by clearing Heat from the Heart. With Mu Tong and Sheng Di Huang , for Heat in the Heart channel manifesting as chest Heat and irritability, mouth and tongue sores and dark, scanty urine.
The tips treat painful urinary dysfunction, relieve toxicity and harmonize.

syndromes: Heat in the Heart and Small Intestine Channels
clinicalManifestations: Irritability with a sensation of Heat in the chest
Thirst with a desire to drink cold beverages
May be sores around the mouth
contraindicationsAndInteractions: Use caution for those with Spleen and Stomach Deficiency.
This formula may not be appropriate for those with repetitive stomatitis.
notes: This formula is especially used for children.

ingredients.actions: Disperses Wind-Cold-Dampness from the Lower Jiao , bones and sinews, vitalizes the vessels and alleviates pain. With Xi Xin, for Shao Yin headache, with splitting pain that involves the teeth and cheeks due to External Wind-Cold and joint pain due to Wind-Cold-Dampness With Xi Xin and Qin Jiao , for Wind-Damp Bi causing numbness, pain and soreness in the neck, back and lower extremities. With Fang Feng, for numbness in the legs.

Releases exterior Wind-Cold, disperses Internal Cold, warms the Lungs transforms Phlegm and scours Wind-Dampness from sinews and bones to stop pain. With Chuan Xiong , for Wind-Cold headache, toothache and Bi pain. With Sheng Di Huang, for a headache and toothache due to Wind-Heat. With Chuan Xiong and Fang Feng, for Bi syndrome. With Du Zhong and Sang Ji Sheng, for chronic low back and knee pain.

Expels Wind-Cold and Dampness and alleviates pain. With Qin Jiao , for Wind-Damp Bi with spasms of the tendons or numbness of the limbs and pain due to Wind-Dampness in patients with Blood Deficiency.
Expels Wind-Dampness and relaxes sinews.

Expels Wind-Dampness, strengthens sinews and bones, tonifies Liver and Kidney Yin and nourishes the Blood. With Du Zhong , and Niu Xi , expels Wind-Dampness and tonifies the Liver and Kidneys. With Xu Duan, Dang Gui and Du Zhong, for restless fetus, and back pain due to Yin and Blood Deficiencies.

(Often substituted for San Ji Sheng .) (With Du Zhong , tonifies Liver and Kidneys, strengthens the lower back and secures the Chong and Ren channels to treat aching in the lower back and knees, weakness of the legs which makes walking difficult and especially threatened miscarriage due to instability of the Chong and Ren channels and restless fetus or bleeding during pregnancy accompanied by lower back pain and a sense of dropping in the lower trunk.)
Tonifies the Kidneys and Liver and strengthens sinews and bones. With Xu Duan, for fractures. With Sang Ji Sheng, Dang Gui and Chuan Xiong, for low back pain during and after menstruation.

Invigorates the Blood, strengthens the sinews and bones, benefits the joints and nourishes the Liver and Kidney Yin . With Sang Ji Sheng and Du Zhong , directs the other herbs toward lower extremities. With Du Zhong, for low back and extremity pain and weakness due to Bi pain or Kidney Deficiency. With Sheng Di Huang, powerfully clears Deficiency Fire Blazing Upward with pain and swelling of the gums, epistaxis, hematemesis and other hemorrhage in the upper body and treats diabetes.

Warms Kidneys, strengthens Yang , strengthens Ming Men Fire, disperses deep Cold, warms and unblocks the channels and vessels to open the lower back and alleviates pain. With Ren Shen and Shu Di Huang, for palpitations and shortness of breath due to Deficiencies of Heart and Kidneys. With Dang Gui and Chuan Xiong, for dysmenorrhea, postpartum abdominal pain or amenorrhea due to Deficiency Cold of the Chong and Ren channels.

Tonifies, invigorates and harmonizes the Blood, disperses Cold and alleviates pain. With Chuan Xiong, harmonizes, nourishes and invigorates the Blood, disperses Blood Stasis and treats abdominal pain. With Chuan Xiong, Sheng Di Huang and Bai Shao , nourishes and invigorates the Blood. With Shu Di Huang, for Heat symptoms due to Yin Deficiency and Devastated Blood. With Bai Shao and Fu Ling, for diarrhea during pregnancy with mild abdominal pain.

Activates Blood, regulates Qi , expels Wind-Cold and alleviates pain. With Dang Gui, for Wind-Damp Invasion blocking the Blood vessels causing pain, numbness, and paralysis. With Sheng Di Huang and Bai Shao, for headache due to Blood Deficiency. With Rou Gui, for irregular menstruation with Cold in the Blood.
Nourishes Yin and Blood and generates fluids. With Bai Shao, for Blood Deficiency Heat.

(Often substituted for Sheng Di Huang due to its stronger nourishing properties.) (With Dang Gui, for Blood Deficiency Heat.) (With Ren Shen, for Qi, Blood and Yin Deficiencies.) (With Dang Gui, Bai Shao and Chuan Xiong, for anemia.)

Nourishes Blood and alleviates pain. With Fu Ling , strengthens the Spleen. With Dang Gui, nourishes Yin and Blood. With Dang Gui and Shu Di Huang , for dizziness, blurred vision, and dysmenorrhea due to Blood Deficiency or Stasis. With Du Huo, Qin Jiao, Ren Shen, Dang Gui and Zhi Gan Cao, for chronic Bi Syndrome with injury to Qi and Blood leading to spasms of the extremities.
Tonifies Qi , calms the Spirit and generates Body Fluids.

(Often substituted for Ren Shen .) (With Fu Ling, for Spleen and Stomach Deficiencies with fatigue, a sensation of fullness in the abdomen, dizziness, lethargy, shortness of breath, anorexia and loose stools or diarrhea.)
Promotes urination, resolves Dampness, strengthens the Spleen and harmonizes the Middle Jiao .
Tonifies Middle Qi and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of the other herbs. With Ren Shen and Fu Ling, strengthens the Spleen and augments Qi.

syndromes: Bi Syndrome with Kidney and Liver Deficiency
Bi Syndrome with Qi and Blood Deficiency
Invasion of the muscles and bones by Wind-Cold-Damp
Atrophy disorder (wasting of the lower extremities)
clinicalManifestations: Heavy and painful sensations at fixed locations in lower back and extremities with weakness and stiffness or hypertonicity and immobility
Pain in the midline and back during pregnancy
Cold pain in the low back and knees
Soreness, weakness and numbness of the joints
C: Thin and white or White and moist
P: Thin, weak and slow or Deep, thready and weak or slippery
treats: Sciatica due to degenerative joint disease
Pain in the midline and back during pregnancy
contraindicationsAndInteractions: Contraindicated for Bi syndrome marked by strong Excess or Damp-Heat.
Contraindicated for Bi syndrome marked by Liver and Kidney Yin Deficiencies.
Use with caution during pregnancy.

ingredients.actions: Tonifies, i nvigorates and harmonizes the Blood, disperses Cold, stops pain due to Blood Stasis, reduces swelling, expels pus, generates flesh and alleviates pain. With Tao Ren and Hong Hua, for pain, swelling and other symptoms associated with Blood Stasis. With Gan Cao, moderates spasms and relieves abdominal pain.
Breaks up Blood Stasis and invigorates Blood circulation. With Hong Hua, Chuan Shan Jia and Da Huang, for External and sports injuries with bleeding and pain.
Invigorates the Blood, dispels Blood Stasis, opens the channels, unblocks menstruation and alleviates pain. With Tao Ren, invigorates the Blood for all types of Blood Stagnation.
Invigorates the Blood, dispels Blood Stasis, reduces swelling, promotes the discharge of pus and expels Wind-Dampness from the channels.
Drains Fire Clears Heat, transforms Dampness, promotes urination, invigorates the Blood and d ispels Blood Stasis. With Dang Gui, for Blood Stasis.
Relieves toxicity, expels pus and r educes swelling.
Spreads Liver Qi and relieves Stagnation . With Bai Shao, for Liver Blood Deficiency with Liver Qi Stagnation. With Gan Cao, for hepatitis and upper right quadrant pain.
Moderates spasms, alleviates pain and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.

clinicalManifestations: Excruciating chest, hypochondriac or flank pain
Pain along the Liver or Gallbladder channel
contraindicationsAndInteractions: Contraindicated during pregnancy.
If this formula leads to diarrhea without a complete cure, use a different formula.
Contraindicated for those who are weak and deficient.
Use with caution for those with Spleen Deficiency.
notes: Loose stools following administration of this formula is a positive sign. Once loose stools and a diminution of the pain have occurred, discontinue use of the formula.

ingredients.actions: Clears Heat, especially in the Upper Jiao and relieves toxicity.
Clears Lung Heat, dries Dampness, drains Fire and detoxifies.

Clears Heat, relieves Fire toxicity, improves the throat, transforms Phlegm and clears the Lungs. With Huang Qin , for sore throat and cough due to Heat in the Lungs.

Promotes urination and drains Heat from the Bladder. expels Damp-Heat and releases Summerheat. With Mu Tong, for Heat Lin .
Promotes urination.

With Shi Chang Pu and Bai Dou Kou , eliminates turbidity and revives the Spleen. Aromatically transforms Dampness, warms the Middle Jiao , descends Qi and s tops vomiting .

ingredients.actions: Discharges Exterior conditions, Raises Yang and releases the muscles especially of the neck and upper back, relieves Heat, generates fluids and relieves thirst. With Huang Qin and Huang Lian , for Heat induced diarrhea and dysenteric disorders due to Damp-Heat.

Clears Lung Heat, drains Fire and detoxifies. With Huang Lian , drains pathogenic Heat from the upper and middle Jiaos for high fever, redness, swelling and pain of the head and face, dry mouth, parched throat, ulcerations of the mouth and tongue, epistaxis, rashes irritability in warm-febrile disease, toothache and explosive diarrhea and dysentery with burning pain in the anus or fitted, filthy stools and abdominal pain.
Drains Fire, relieves toxicity, clears Heart Fire and drains Stomach Fire. With Huang Lian, Huang Qin and Ge Gen, for External Heat with diarrhea or dysentery.
Moderates and harmonizes the properties of other herbs.

Diarrhea and dysentery whether or not there is Wind Invasion.

Irritability and Heat in the chest and epigastrium

treats: Diarrhea as a complication of AIDS/HIV

ingredients.actions: Induces vomiting to relieve Phlegm-Heat or retained food, dispels Damp-Heat and relieves jaundice. With Chi Xiao Dou, induces vomiting to treat Phlegm or retained food above the diaphragm, very early stages of food poisoning and hot Phlegm.
Promotes urination, reduces edema, clears Damp Heat , disperses Blood Stasis, reduces swelling and reduces Fire toxicity.
Releases the Exterior, eliminates irritability, harmonizes the Middle Jiao and relieves stuffy sensations in the chest .

formulaActions: Discharges Phlegm or Food Stagnation through vomiting
syndromes: Phlegm clogging the chest and diaphragm
Food Stagnation lodging in the epigastrium
clinicalManifestations: Firm areas of focal distention in the chest
Difficult breathing due to a sensation of Qi rushing to the throat
P: Slightly floating at the distal position
contraindicationsAndInteractions: Use with caution for weak patients or those with Spleen and Stomach Deficiency.
Use with caution for children, the elderly, postpartum patients and those with dizziness and palpitations due to Qi and Blood Deficiency.
Contraindicated when Phlegm is not lodged in the chest.
Contraindicated when Food Stagnation has passed into the Intestines.
Do not use this formula to induce vomiting of corrosive substances.
If the formula causes unremitting vomiting, administer 0.3-0.6 Flos Caryophylli Ding Xiang or Moschus She Xiang .
notes: Grind the ingredients into a paste and take 1-3g at a time with a decoction of Dan Dou Chi. If vomiting does not ensue, slightly increase the dosage,

Astringes sweat, astringes the Kidneys and stops bleeding . With Bai Zhu, Huang Qi and Hai Piao Xiao, for uterine bleeding or profuse menstruation from Spleen Qi Deficiency.

Cools the Blood and stops bleeding . With Hai Piao Xiao, for excessive uterine bleeding. With Hai Piao Xiao and Huang Qi, for Qi Deficient uterine bleeding. With Long Gu, for Blood-streaked leukorrhea.

ingredients.actions: Tonifies Spleen, Heart and Yuan Qi . With Bai Zhu, tonifies the transformation and transportation functions of the Spleen. With Huang Qi, Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , tonifies the Spleen to generate Blood. With Bai Zhu and Fu Ling , for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiency. With Dang Gui, Long Yan Rou and Yuan Zhi , for Heart and Spleen Deficiency.
(May substitute for Ren Shen .)

Tonifies Blood and Spleen Qi . With Dang Gui , generates and nourishes Blood. With Ren Shen, for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia, and spontaneous sweat. With Bai Zhu, for Spleen Qi Deficiency with weakness, lassitude and loose stools. With Long Yan Rou, Dang Gui and Suan Zao Ren, for insomnia and other signs of Qi and Blood Deficiency.
Strengthens the Spleen and dries Dampness.

Strengthens the Spleen and harmonizes the Middle Jiao . With Ren Shen and Huang Qi , tonifies the Spleen. With Ren Shen and Bai Zhu for weak and deficient Spleen with fatigue, anorexia and loose stools. With Gan Cao, for Spleen and Heart Deficiency causing facial edema, palpitations, and short-ness of breath. With Dang Shen, Suan Zao Ren and Long Yan Rou, for insomnia due to Spleen and Heart Insufficiency.
(Usually used in place of Fu Ling . Pacifies the Heart, calms the Shen and soothes the nerves.) (With Suan Zao Ren , calms the Shen .)
Nourishes Heart Yin and tonifies Liver Blood. With Ren Shen , Fu Shen and Long Yan Rou , for insomnia, palpitations and irritability due to Spleen Qi and Heart Blood Deficiency.

Nourishes the Blood, calms the Shen , and tonifies and nourishes the Heart and Spleen. With Ren Shen , Dang Gui and Suan Zao Ren , for palpitations and insomnia due to Heart Blood Deficiency, especially in cases with Spleen Qi Deficiency.
Regulates Qi , strengthens the Spleen and prevents indigestion due to the rich nature of the other herbs. With Bai Zhu , especially effective.
Harmonizes and tonifies Qi . With Fu Ling and Dang Shen, strengthens the Spleen, augments Qi and treats palpitations due to Heart Qi Deficiency. With Ren Shen, relieves palpitations and anxiety.
Nourishes and harmonizes the Blood. With Huang Qi, for many Blood Deficiency patterns.

Calms the Shen , sedates the Heart and opens Orifices. With Suan Zao Ren , it is especially effective because it balances the contracting, introverted and dispersing, extroverted manifestations of Spirit to ensure the proper balance of openness and sobriety. With Fu Shen and Suan Zao Ren , for symptoms of Heart Blood Deficiency. With Suan Zao Ren, Bai Zhu and Dang Gui, for palpitations and insomnia due to Qi Deficiency . With Huang Qi, Dang Gui and Long Yan Rou, for forgetfulness, palpitations and insomnia.
Aids in strengthening the Spleen. With Da Zao , improves the appetite and regulates the Ying and Wei , facilitating the actions of the formula.

Nourishes the Blood, calms the Shen , tonifies the Qi and harmonizes. With Bai Zhu and Dang Shen, for weakness and lassitude due to Spleen and Stomach Deficiency. With Sheng Jiang, prevents tonics from generating Dampness in the Middle Jiao .

ingredients.actions: Tonifies Spleen, Heart and Yuan Qi . With Bai Zhu, tonifies the transformation and transportation functions of the Spleen. With Huang Qi, Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , tonifies the Spleen to generate Blood. With Bai Zhu and Fu Ling , for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiency. With Dang Gui, Long Yan Rou and Yuan Zhi , for Heart and Spleen Deficiency.
(May substitute for Ren Shen .)

Tonifies Blood and Spleen Qi . With Dang Gui , generates and nourishes Blood. With Ren Shen, for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia, and spontaneous sweat. With Bai Zhu, for Spleen Qi Deficiency with weakness, lassitude and loose stools. With Long Yan Rou, Dang Gui and Suan Zao Ren, for insomnia and other signs of Qi and Blood Deficiency.
Strengthens the Spleen and dries Dampness.

Strengthens the Spleen and harmonizes the Middle Jiao . With Ren Shen and Huang Qi , tonifies the Spleen. With Ren Shen and Bai Zhu for weak and deficient Spleen with fatigue, anorexia and loose stools. With Gan Cao, for Spleen and Heart Deficiency causing facial edema, palpitations, and short-ness of breath. With Dang Shen, Suan Zao Ren and Long Yan Rou, for insomnia due to Spleen and Heart Insufficiency.
(Usually used in place of Fu Ling . Pacifies the Heart, calms the Shen and soothes the nerves.) (With Suan Zao Ren , calms the Shen .)
Nourishes Heart Yin and tonifies Liver Blood. With Ren Shen , Fu Shen and Long Yan Rou , for insomnia, palpitations and irritability due to Spleen Qi and Heart Blood Deficiency.

Nourishes the Blood, calms the Shen , and tonifies and nourishes the Heart and Spleen. With Ren Shen , Dang Gui and Suan Zao Ren , for palpitations and insomnia due to Heart Blood Deficiency, especially in cases with Spleen Qi Deficiency.
Regulates Qi , strengthens the Spleen and prevents indigestion due to the rich nature of the other herbs. With Bai Zhu , especially effective.
Harmonizes and tonifies Qi . With Fu Ling and Dang Shen, strengthens the Spleen, augments Qi and treats palpitations due to Heart Qi Deficiency. With Ren Shen, relieves palpitations and anxiety.
Nourishes and harmonizes the Blood. With Huang Qi, for many Blood Deficiency patterns.

Calms the Shen , sedates the Heart and opens Orifices. With Suan Zao Ren , it is especially effective because it balances the contracting, introverted and dispersing, extroverted manifestations of Spirit to ensure the proper balance of openness and sobriety. With Fu Shen and Suan Zao Ren , for symptoms of Heart Blood Deficiency. With Suan Zao Ren, Bai Zhu and Dang Gui, for palpitations and insomnia due to Qi Deficiency . With Huang Qi, Dang Gui and Long Yan Rou, for forgetfulness, palpitations and insomnia.
Aids in strengthening the Spleen. With Da Zao , improves the appetite and regulates the Ying and Wei , facilitating the actions of the formula.

Nourishes the Blood, calms the Shen , tonifies the Qi and harmonizes. With Bai Zhu and Dang Shen, for weakness and lassitude due to Spleen and Stomach Deficiency. With Sheng Jiang, prevents tonics from generating Dampness in the Middle Jiao .

P: Thready and weak or Thready and moderate
treats: Acute myelitis (inflammation of the spinal cord)
contraindicationsAndInteractions: Contraindicated for those with Interior Heat.
Contraindicated for those with Yin Deficiency with Heat signs.

ingredients.actions: Tonifies Spleen, Heart and Yuan Qi . With Bai Zhu, tonifies the transformation and transportation functions of the Spleen. With Huang Qi, Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , tonifies the Spleen to generate Blood. With Bai Zhu and Fu Ling , for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiency. With Dang Gui, Long Yan Rou and Yuan Zhi , for Heart and Spleen Deficiency.
(May substitute for Ren Shen .)

Tonifies Blood and Spleen Qi . With Dang Gui , generates and nourishes Blood. With Ren Shen, for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia, and spontaneous sweat. With Bai Zhu, for Spleen Qi Deficiency with weakness, lassitude and loose stools. With Long Yan Rou, Dang Gui and Suan Zao Ren, for insomnia and other signs of Qi and Blood Deficiency.
Strengthens the Spleen and dries Dampness.

Strengthens the Spleen and harmonizes the Middle Jiao . With Ren Shen and Huang Qi , tonifies the Spleen. With Ren Shen and Bai Zhu for weak and deficient Spleen with fatigue, anorexia and loose stools. With Gan Cao, for Spleen and Heart Deficiency causing facial edema, palpitations, and short-ness of breath. With Dang Shen, Suan Zao Ren and Long Yan Rou, for insomnia due to Spleen and Heart Insufficiency.
(Usually used in place of Fu Ling . Pacifies the Heart, calms the Shen and soothes the nerves.) (With Suan Zao Ren , calms the Shen .)
Nourishes Heart Yin and tonifies Liver Blood. With Ren Shen , Fu Shen and Long Yan Rou , for insomnia, palpitations and irritability due to Spleen Qi and Heart Blood Deficiency.

Nourishes the Blood, calms the Shen , and tonifies and nourishes the Heart and Spleen. With Ren Shen , Dang Gui and Suan Zao Ren , for palpitations and insomnia due to Heart Blood Deficiency, especially in cases with Spleen Qi Deficiency.
Regulates Qi , strengthens the Spleen and prevents indigestion due to the rich nature of the other herbs. With Bai Zhu , especially effective.
Harmonizes and tonifies Qi . With Fu Ling and Dang Shen, strengthens the Spleen, augments Qi and treats palpitations due to Heart Qi Deficiency. With Ren Shen, relieves palpitations and anxiety.
Nourishes and harmonizes the Blood. With Huang Qi, for many Blood Deficiency patterns.

Calms the Shen , sedates the Heart and opens Orifices. With Suan Zao Ren , it is especially effective because it balances the contracting, introverted and dispersing, extroverted manifestations of Spirit to ensure the proper balance of openness and sobriety. With Fu Shen and Suan Zao Ren , for symptoms of Heart Blood Deficiency. With Suan Zao Ren, Bai Zhu and Dang Gui, for palpitations and insomnia due to Qi Deficiency . With Huang Qi, Dang Gui and Long Yan Rou, for forgetfulness, palpitations and insomnia.
Aids in strengthening the Spleen. With Da Zao , improves the appetite and regulates the Ying and Wei , facilitating the actions of the formula.

Nourishes the Blood, calms the Shen , tonifies the Qi and harmonizes. With Bai Zhu and Dang Shen, for weakness and lassitude due to Spleen and Stomach Deficiency. With Sheng Jiang, prevents tonics from generating Dampness in the Middle Jiao .

syndromes: Heart (Blood) and Spleen (Qi) Deficiency due to worry (excessive deliberation or obsession)

clinicalManifestations: Early menstruation with copious pale blood
Dizziness (mild and postural, worse with sitting or rising or lying down or when fatigued)
P: Thready and weak or Thready and moderate
treats: Acute myelitis (inflammation of the spinal cord)
contraindicationsAndInteractions: Contraindicated for those with Interior Heat.
Contraindicated for those with Yin Deficiency with Heat signs.

ingredients.actions: Tonifies Spleen, Heart and Yuan Qi . With Bai Zhu, tonifies the transformation and transportation functions of the Spleen. With Huang Qi, Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , tonifies the Spleen to generate Blood. With Bai Zhu and Fu Ling , for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiency. With Dang Gui, Long Yan Rou and Yuan Zhi , for Heart and Spleen Deficiency.
(May substitute for Ren Shen .)

Tonifies Blood and Spleen Qi . With Dang Gui , generates and nourishes Blood. With Ren Shen, for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia, and spontaneous sweat. With Bai Zhu, for Spleen Qi Deficiency with weakness, lassitude and loose stools. With Long Yan Rou, Dang Gui and Suan Zao Ren, for insomnia and other signs of Qi and Blood Deficiency.
Strengthens the Spleen and dries Dampness.

Strengthens the Spleen and harmonizes the Middle Jiao . With Ren Shen and Huang Qi , tonifies the Spleen. With Ren Shen and Bai Zhu for weak and deficient Spleen with fatigue, anorexia and loose stools. With Gan Cao, for Spleen and Heart Deficiency causing facial edema, palpitations, and short-ness of breath. With Dang Shen, Suan Zao Ren and Long Yan Rou, for insomnia due to Spleen and Heart Insufficiency.
(Usually used in place of Fu Ling . Pacifies the Heart, calms the Shen and soothes the nerves.) (With Suan Zao Ren , calms the Shen .)
Nourishes Heart Yin and tonifies Liver Blood. With Ren Shen , Fu Shen and Long Yan Rou , for insomnia, palpitations and irritability due to Spleen Qi and Heart Blood Deficiency.

Nourishes the Blood, calms the Shen , and tonifies and nourishes the Heart and Spleen. With Ren Shen , Dang Gui and Suan Zao Ren , for palpitations and insomnia due to Heart Blood Deficiency, especially in cases with Spleen Qi Deficiency.
Regulates Qi , strengthens the Spleen and prevents indigestion due to the rich nature of the other herbs. With Bai Zhu , especially effective.
Harmonizes and tonifies Qi . With Fu Ling and Dang Shen, strengthens the Spleen, augments Qi and treats palpitations due to Heart Qi Deficiency. With Ren Shen, relieves palpitations and anxiety.
Nourishes and harmonizes the Blood. With Huang Qi, for many Blood Deficiency patterns.

Calms the Shen , sedates the Heart and opens Orifices. With Suan Zao Ren , it is especially effective because it balances the contracting, introverted and dispersing, extroverted manifestations of Spirit to ensure the proper balance of openness and sobriety. With Fu Shen and Suan Zao Ren , for symptoms of Heart Blood Deficiency. With Suan Zao Ren, Bai Zhu and Dang Gui, for palpitations and insomnia due to Qi Deficiency . With Huang Qi, Dang Gui and Long Yan Rou, for forgetfulness, palpitations and insomnia.
Aids in strengthening the Spleen. With Da Zao , improves the appetite and regulates the Ying and Wei , facilitating the actions of the formula.

Nourishes the Blood, calms the Shen , tonifies the Qi and harmonizes. With Bai Zhu and Dang Shen, for weakness and lassitude due to Spleen and Stomach Deficiency. With Sheng Jiang, prevents tonics from generating Dampness in the Middle Jiao .

ingredients.actions: Tonifies Spleen, Heart and Yuan Qi . With Bai Zhu, tonifies the transformation and transportation functions of the Spleen. With Huang Qi, Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , tonifies the Spleen to generate Blood. With Bai Zhu and Fu Ling , for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiency. With Dang Gui, Long Yan Rou and Yuan Zhi , for Heart and Spleen Deficiency.
(May substitute for Ren Shen .)

Tonifies Blood and Spleen Qi . With Dang Gui , generates and nourishes Blood. With Ren Shen, for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia, and spontaneous sweat. With Bai Zhu, for Spleen Qi Deficiency with weakness, lassitude and loose stools. With Long Yan Rou, Dang Gui and Suan Zao Ren, for insomnia and other signs of Qi and Blood Deficiency.
Strengthens the Spleen and dries Dampness.

Strengthens the Spleen and harmonizes the Middle Jiao . With Ren Shen and Huang Qi , tonifies the Spleen. With Ren Shen and Bai Zhu for weak and deficient Spleen with fatigue, anorexia and loose stools. With Gan Cao, for Spleen and Heart Deficiency causing facial edema, palpitations, and short-ness of breath. With Dang Shen, Suan Zao Ren and Long Yan Rou, for insomnia due to Spleen and Heart Insufficiency.
(Usually used in place of Fu Ling . Pacifies the Heart, calms the Shen and soothes the nerves.) (With Suan Zao Ren , calms the Shen .)
Nourishes Heart Yin and tonifies Liver Blood. With Ren Shen , Fu Shen and Long Yan Rou , for insomnia, palpitations and irritability due to Spleen Qi and Heart Blood Deficiency.

Nourishes the Blood, calms the Shen , and tonifies and nourishes the Heart and Spleen. With Ren Shen , Dang Gui and Suan Zao Ren , for palpitations and insomnia due to Heart Blood Deficiency, especially in cases with Spleen Qi Deficiency.
Regulates Qi , strengthens the Spleen and prevents indigestion due to the rich nature of the other herbs. With Bai Zhu , especially effective.
Harmonizes and tonifies Qi . With Fu Ling and Dang Shen, strengthens the Spleen, augments Qi and treats palpitations due to Heart Qi Deficiency. With Ren Shen, relieves palpitations and anxiety.
Nourishes and harmonizes the Blood. With Huang Qi, for many Blood Deficiency patterns.

Calms the Shen , sedates the Heart and opens Orifices. With Suan Zao Ren , it is especially effective because it balances the contracting, introverted and dispersing, extroverted manifestations of Spirit to ensure the proper balance of openness and sobriety. With Fu Shen and Suan Zao Ren , for symptoms of Heart Blood Deficiency. With Suan Zao Ren, Bai Zhu and Dang Gui, for palpitations and insomnia due to Qi Deficiency . With Huang Qi, Dang Gui and Long Yan Rou, for forgetfulness, palpitations and insomnia.
Aids in strengthening the Spleen. With Da Zao , improves the appetite and regulates the Ying and Wei , facilitating the actions of the formula.

Nourishes the Blood, calms the Shen , tonifies the Qi and harmonizes. With Bai Zhu and Dang Shen, for weakness and lassitude due to Spleen and Stomach Deficiency. With Sheng Jiang, prevents tonics from generating Dampness in the Middle Jiao .

ingredients.actions: Tonifies Spleen, Heart and Yuan Qi . With Bai Zhu, tonifies the transformation and transportation functions of the Spleen. With Huang Qi, Bai Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao , tonifies the Spleen to generate Blood. With Bai Zhu and Fu Ling , for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiency. With Dang Gui, Long Yan Rou and Yuan Zhi , for Heart and Spleen Deficiency.
(May substitute for Ren Shen .)

Tonifies Blood and Spleen Qi . With Dang Gui , generates and nourishes Blood. With Ren Shen, for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia, and spontaneous sweat. With Bai Zhu, for Spleen Qi Deficiency with weakness, lassitude and loose stools. With Long Yan Rou, Dang Gui and Suan Zao Ren, for insomnia and other signs of Qi and Blood Deficiency.
Strengthens the Spleen and dries Dampness.

Strengthens the Spleen and harmonizes the Middle Jiao . With Ren Shen and Huang Qi , tonifies the Spleen. With Ren Shen and Bai Zhu for weak and deficient Spleen with fatigue, anorexia and loose stools. With Gan Cao, for Spleen and Heart Deficiency causing facial edema, palpitations, and short-ness of breath. With Dang Shen, Suan Zao Ren and Long Yan Rou, for insomnia due to Spleen and Heart Insufficiency.
(Usually used in place of Fu Ling . Pacifies the Heart, calms the Shen and soothes the nerves.) (With Suan Zao Ren , calms the Shen .)
Nourishes Heart Yin and tonifies Liver Blood. With Ren Shen , Fu Shen and Long Yan Rou , for insomnia, palpitations and irritability due to Spleen Qi and Heart Blood Deficiency.

Nourishes the Blood, calms the Shen , and tonifies and nourishes the Heart and Spleen. With Ren Shen , Dang Gui and Suan Zao Ren , for palpitations and insomnia due to Heart Blood Deficiency, especially in cases with Spleen Qi Deficiency.
Regulates Qi , strengthens the Spleen and prevents indigestion due to the rich nature of the other herbs. With Bai Zhu , especially effective.
Harmonizes and tonifies Qi . With Fu Ling and Dang Shen, strengthens the Spleen, augments Qi and treats palpitations due to Heart Qi Deficiency. With Ren Shen, relieves palpitations and anxiety.
Nourishes and harmonizes the Blood. With Huang Qi, for many Blood Deficiency patterns.

Calms the Shen , sedates the Heart and opens Orifices. With Suan Zao Ren , it is especially effective because it balances the contracting, introverted and dispersing, extroverted manifestations of Spirit to ensure the proper balance of openness and sobriety. With Fu Shen and Suan Zao Ren , for symptoms of Heart Blood Deficiency. With Suan Zao Ren, Bai Zhu and Dang Gui, for palpitations and insomnia due to Qi Deficiency . With Huang Qi, Dang Gui and Long Yan Rou, for forgetfulness, palpitations and insomnia.
Aids in strengthening the Spleen. With Da Zao , improves the appetite and regulates the Ying and Wei , facilitating the actions of the formula.

Nourishes the Blood, calms the Shen , tonifies the Qi and harmonizes. With Bai Zhu and Dang Shen, for weakness and lassitude due to Spleen and Stomach Deficiency. With Sheng Jiang, prevents tonics from generating Dampness in the Middle Jiao .

ingredients.actions: Unblocks Yang , transforms Qi, warms the Middle and directs Turbid Yin downward, warms the channels, collaterals and Blood through the vessels to relieve pain and warms and facilitates the flow of Yang Qi in the chest. With Bai Shao , warms and tonifies the Middle Jiao . With Fu Ling, unblocks the Yang and facilitates the removal of congested fluids associated with Yang Deficiency edema. With Fu Ling and Bai Shao, for Heart and Spleen Yang Deficiency with palpitations, edema and shortness of breath. With Dan Shen, for palpitations and chest pain due to Heart Yang Deficiency and subsequent painful obstruction due to Blood Stasis blocking the channels. With Tao Ren and Mu Dan Pi, for gynecological discomfort due to Blood Stasis and lower abdominal masses. With Tao Ren, Mu Dan Pi and Fu Ling, for amenorrhea and abdominal pain due to Cold Invasion and Blood Stasis.
Promotes urination, resolves Dampness, strengthens the Spleen, harmonizes the Middle Jiao and transforms Phlegm. With Gui Zhi , warms and transforms fluids, unblocks Yang and promotes urination.

Clears Heat, cools the Blood, activates Blood, dispels Blood Stasis and eliminates pain. With Tao Ren , for Blood Stasis induced menstrual disorders, especially those characterized by early period, excessive bleeding, and thick purple clots. With Bai Shao, for spasms and cramping pain associated with Blood Deficiency and Blood Stagnation. With Mu Dan Pi, for Blood Stasis disorders (amenorrhea, menstrual pain, traumatic injury).

(Nourishes Blood, r egulates menstruation, benefits Yin , astringes weak Ying Qi, softens the Liver and relieves pain. ) With Gui Zhi , harmonizes the Ying and Wei and warms and tonifies the Middle Jiao .)

ingredients.actions: Clears Heat and Phlegm from the Gallbladder and Stomach, cools Blood and descends rebellious Qi . With Zhi Ban Xia and Zhi Shi , for insomnia, palpitations and irritability due to Phlegm Heat leading to disharmony between the Gallbladder and Stomach with a stifling sensation in the chest and restlessness With Zhi Ban Xia, Chen Pi and Huang Lian, for .Phlegm-Heat in the Stomach with a stifling feeling in the epigastrium and vomiting. With Zhi Shi, for Phlegm-Heat obstructing the flow of Qi with focal distention in the chest and epigastrium, hiccup, dry retching, nausea and acid regurgitation and palpitations, irritability, insomnia and emotional problems due to Gallbladder constraint with Phlegm Disturbing the Heart. With Z hi Ban Xia, Chen , Pi, Zhi Shi and Fu Ling, for Gallbladder Fire with Phlegm.
Reduces accumulation, descends Qi , transforms Phlegm and reduces distention. With Chen Pi , strengthens the Middle Jiao .

Transforms Phlegm, descends rebellious Qi , harmonizes ST and stops vomiting. With Chen Pi, for Spleen and Stomach Qi Disharmony with epigastric and abdominal distention or pain. With Fu Ling, expels Phlegm and stops nausea and vomiting, hiccups, coughs with clear, profuse Phlegm and loose and watery stools, treats Phlegm, thin mucus and turbid Dampness and prevents turbid Phlegm and Dampness from disturbing the Heart with dizziness, palpitations and insomnia. With Huang Lian, for epigastric distention and indigestion due to a simultaneous invasion of Hot and Cold pathogenic influences into the Stomach. With Huang Lian and Zhu Ru, for vomiting from Stomach Heat.

Regulates Qi , tonifies the Spleen, transforms Phlegm and descends Qi . With Ban Xia, for excessive white, viscous sputum due to Phlegm-Damp Obstruction. With Sheng Jiang , for manifestations of Stomach Qi Disharmony and Cold-Dampness Obstructing the Middle with nausea and hiccup. With Zhu Ru and Huang Lian , for Phlegm-Heat induced vomiting. With Zhi Ban Xia, Zhu Ru and Sheng Jiang, for nausea and vomiting due to rebellious Stomach Qi .

Resolves Dampness, strengthens the Spleen, harmonizes the Middle Jiao and transforms Phlegm . With Zhi Gan Cao , strengthens the Spleen, drains Dampness, harmonizes the Middle Jiao and calms the Shen . With Chen Pi , for nausea and vomiting due to congested Fluids. With Zhi Ban Xia and Chen Pi, for nausea, vomiting, chest fullness and distention, and anorexia due to congested fluids. With Zhi Ban Xia, Chen Pi and Sheng Jiang, for Congested fluids in the Stomach causing nausea and vomiting.
Resolves Phlegm, clears Heat, tonifies the Spleen and harmonizes and moderates the harsh properties of the other herbs.

Tonifies the Spleen and Stomach, augments Qi, protects the Stomach and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs . With Sheng Jian, alleviates epigastric pain, nausea, and vomiting by strengthening the Spleen.

Regulates the relationship between the Gallbladder and the Stomach and assists in stopping vomiting. With Da Zao , protects the Stomach Qi . With Zhi Ban Xia , for vomiting due to Cold, Thin Mucus. With Zhu Ru, for vomiting due to Heat in patients with Stomach Qi Deficiency. . With Zhu Ru and Huang Lian, for vomiting due to Heat. With Chen Pi, for Cold-Dampness Obstructing the Middle with nausea and hiccup.
Clears Heart Heat and calms the Shen .

ingredients.actions: Tonifies the Kidney Yang , benefits Jing and stops leakage of semen. (Not included in some versions.) With Qian Shi, for nocturnal emission and spermatorrhea. With Lian Zi , for nocturnal emission and spermatorrhea. With Quan Shi and Lian Zi , for Liver and Kidney Deficiency with symptoms of Jing Gate Not Consolidated. With Bai Ji Li, tonifies the Liver and Kidneys to ensure that the eyes are nourished, anchors Liver Yang and expels Wind-Heat to treat many eye disorders, especially when there is Liver and Kidney Deficiency with either Liver Qi Stagnation with Liver Yang Rising or External Wind-Heat affecting the eyes.

Stabilizes the Kidneys, astringes Jing and dispels Dampness. With Lian Zi, reestablishes communication between the Heart and Kidneys, treats nocturnal emissions, premature ejaculation, or urinary incontinence due to the failure of the Kidney's storage functions and inhibits chronic diarrhea or dysentery, watery and thin vaginal discharge, and turbid, painful urinary dysfunction due to Spleen Deficiency or Spleen and Kidney Deficiency. With Jin Ying Zi , Sha Yuan Zi, and Su Zhi Long Gu, tonifies Kidney Qi and strengthens Jing, for vaginal discharge, cloudy urine, spermatorrhea, premature ejaculation, urinary frequency and vaginal discharge due to Kidney Deficiency an loose stools and diarrhea due to Spleen Deficiency.

Stabilizes the Kidneys and nourishes Jing . With Lian Zi, for seminal emission. With Sha Yuan Zi, Qian Shi and Su Zhi Long Gu, for loss of sperm and tinnitus. With Jin Ying Zi and Qian Shi, for vaginal discharge form Kidney Deficiency.

Anchors and preserves floating Yang and prevents leakage of Fluids. With Duan Mu Li , strongly suppresses Blazing Fire and assists in preventing spermatorrhea. With Sha Yuan Zi and Qian Shi , for spermatorrhea due to Kidney Deficiency.

ingredients.actions: Drains Shi Heat from the Liver/Gallbladder, drains Liver Fire and eliminates Damp-Heat from Lower Jiao . With Chai Hu and Huang Qin , for Liver/ Gallbladder Damp-Heat.
Drains Fire, dries Dampness and calms ascending Liver Yang . With Zhi Zi , drains Fire and eliminates Dampness.
Clears Heat, eliminates irritability and drains Damp-Heat. With Huang Qin , drains Fire and eliminates Dampness.
Promotes urination. With Che Qian Zi and Ze Xie , drains Heat from Upper Jiao and eliminates Damp-Heat from Lower Jiao through the urine.
Promotes urination and clears Heat.
Promotes urination and clears Damp Heat.

Disperses Heat due to Liver/Gallbladder Qi Stagnation and focuses the actions of the formula on Liver/Gallbladder. (Omitted in some versions). With Huang Qin , clears Shao Yang Heat. With Gan Cao , for hepatitis and upper right quadrant pain.
Nourishes Yin and clears Heat. With Dang Gui , protects Yin and Blood.
Nourishes Blood without causing Stasis. With Sheng Di Huang , protects Yin and Blood
Harmonizes the Middle Jiao and regulates other herbs.

long-dan-xie-gan-tang-819cb401.englishName: Gentiana Longdancao Decoction to Drain the Liver
alsoKnownAs: Gentiana Combination Decoction to Purge Liver Fire with Gentiana

ingredients.actions: Drains Shi Heat from the Liver/Gallbladder, drains Liver Fire and eliminates Damp-Heat from Lower Jiao . With Chai Hu and Huang Qin , for Liver/ Gallbladder Damp-Heat.
Drains Fire, dries Dampness and calms ascending Liver Yang . With Zhi Zi , drains Fire and eliminates Dampness.
Clears Heat, eliminates irritability and drains Damp-Heat. With Huang Qin , drains Fire and eliminates Dampness.
Promotes urination. With Che Qian Zi and Ze Xie , drains Heat from Upper Jiao and eliminates Damp-Heat from Lower Jiao through the urine.
Promotes urination and clears Heat.
Promotes urination and clears Damp Heat.

Disperses Heat due to Liver/Gallbladder Qi Stagnation and focuses the actions of the formula on Liver/Gallbladder. (Omitted in some versions). With Huang Qin , clears Shao Yang Heat. With Gan Cao , for hepatitis and upper right quadrant pain.
Nourishes Yin and clears Heat. With Dang Gui , protects Yin and Blood.
Nourishes Blood without causing Stasis. With Sheng Di Huang , protects Yin and Blood
Harmonizes the Middle Jiao and regulates other herbs.

formulaActions: Drains Excess Fire from the Liver and Gallbladder
Clears and Drains Damp-Heat from the Lower Jiao
Clears Damp-Heat from the San Jiao
syndromes: Damp-Heat in the Liver and Gallbladder
clinicalManifestations: Difficult and painful urination with a heat sensation in the urethra
Short menstrual cycle with reddish-purple blood

treats: Acute pyogenic infection of the perineum
Acute pyogenic infection of the penis
Boils and carbuncles of the vestibular and external auditory canal
contraindicationsAndInteractions: Use caution for those with Spleen and Stomach Deficiency Cold.
Contraindicated for those with Yin, Yang or Blood Deficiency.
Contraindicated for long-term use.

alsoKnownAs: Gentiana Combination Decoction to Purge Liver Fire with Gentiana

ingredients.actions: Drains Shi Heat from the Liver/Gallbladder, drains Liver Fire and eliminates Damp-Heat from Lower Jiao . With Chai Hu and Huang Qin , for Liver/ Gallbladder Damp-Heat.
Drains Fire, dries Dampness and calms ascending Liver Yang . With Zhi Zi , drains Fire and eliminates Dampness.
Clears Heat, eliminates irritability and drains Damp-Heat. With Huang Qin , drains Fire and eliminates Dampness.
Promotes urination. With Che Qian Zi and Ze Xie , drains Heat from Upper Jiao and eliminates Damp-Heat from Lower Jiao through the urine.
Promotes urination and clears Heat.
Promotes urination and clears Damp Heat.

Disperses Heat due to Liver/Gallbladder Qi Stagnation and focuses the actions of the formula on Liver/Gallbladder. (Omitted in some versions). With Huang Qin , clears Shao Yang Heat. With Gan Cao , for hepatitis and upper right quadrant pain.
Nourishes Yin and clears Heat. With Dang Gui , protects Yin and Blood.
Nourishes Blood without causing Stasis. With Sheng Di Huang , protects Yin and Blood
Harmonizes the Middle Jiao and regulates other herbs.

formulaActions: Drains Excess Fire from the Liver and Gallbladder

treats: Acute pyogenic infection of the perineum

Contraindicated for long-term use.

Dispels Heat Toxins.
(Drains Heat from the Lungs, stops cough, calms wheezing, promotes urination and reduces edema. Usually substitutes for Zi Bai Pi.)

ingredients.actions: Dispels Lower Jiao Dampness and strengthens the transporting function of the Spleen . With Hou Po , dries Dampness and tonifies the Spleen. With Hou Po and Chen Pi, for epigastric fullness, fatigue and discomfort, anorexia, vomiting and/or diarrhea with a turbid, greasy tongue due to Dampness Obstructing the Middle Jiao. With Da Zao, for chronic accumulation of Dampness in the Spleen with hypochondriac pain, acid reflux and anorexia.

Circulates Qi , dispels Dampness, disperses fullness and warms and invigorates the Spleen. With Chen Pi , revives the Spleen and increases the appetite. With Cang Zhu, for Dampness obstructing Spleen Yang with epigastric fullness, abdominal and epigastric distention, nausea, vomiting, anorexia, loss of taste and a thick, greasy tongue coat. With Cang Zhu and Chen P i, for Stomach Excess.

Regulates Qi , transforms Dampness and assists Hou Po in descending Qi and eliminating distention. With Sheng Jiang , for vomiting and hiccups due to Disharmony of the Stomach Qi and Cold-Dampness Obstructing the Middle with nausea and hiccup.
Tonifies the Spleen and augments Qi and moderates and harmonizes the properties of other herbs.

Disperses Cold, warms the Middle and stops vomiting. With Da Zao , alleviates epigastric pain, nausea, and vomiting by strengthening the Spleen, protects Stomach Qi and reduces irritation of the gastrointestinal. tract by other herbs.
Strengthens the Spleen, tonifies Qi and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs .

alsoKnownAs: Magnolia and Ginger Formula Powder for Regulating the Function of the Stomach The Stomach Neutralizing Powder

ingredients.actions: Dispels Lower Jiao Dampness and strengthens the transporting function of the Spleen . With Hou Po , dries Dampness and tonifies the Spleen. With Hou Po and Chen Pi, for epigastric fullness, fatigue and discomfort, anorexia, vomiting and/or diarrhea with a turbid, greasy tongue due to Dampness Obstructing the Middle Jiao. With Da Zao, for chronic accumulation of Dampness in the Spleen with hypochondriac pain, acid reflux and anorexia.

Circulates Qi , dispels Dampness, disperses fullness and warms and invigorates the Spleen. With Chen Pi , revives the Spleen and increases the appetite. With Cang Zhu, for Dampness obstructing Spleen Yang with epigastric fullness, abdominal and epigastric distention, nausea, vomiting, anorexia, loss of taste and a thick, greasy tongue coat. With Cang Zhu and Chen P i, for Stomach Excess.

Regulates Qi , transforms Dampness and assists Hou Po in descending Qi and eliminating distention. With Sheng Jiang , for vomiting and hiccups due to Disharmony of the Stomach Qi and Cold-Dampness Obstructing the Middle with nausea and hiccup.
Tonifies the Spleen and augments Qi and moderates and harmonizes the properties of other herbs.

Disperses Cold, warms the Middle and stops vomiting. With Da Zao , alleviates epigastric pain, nausea, and vomiting by strengthening the Spleen, protects Stomach Qi and reduces irritation of the gastrointestinal. tract by other herbs.
Strengthens the Spleen, tonifies Qi and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs .

syndromes: Damp Stagnation in the Spleen and Stomach
clinicalManifestations: Distention and fullness in epigastrium and abdomen
Heavy sensation in the limbs and body
Loose stools or diarrhea after eating
Feeling lazy with a preference for inactivity
P: Slippery and even or Slow or Moderate
contraindicationsAndInteractions: Modify significantly for those with Yin or Blood Deficiency.
Use caution during pregnancy.
