ingredients.actions: Tonifies Yuan Qi and Spleen, Lung and Heart Qi . With Bai Zhu , strengthens the Spleen and augments Qi .
Tonifies the Spleen, tonifies Qi and dries Dampness.
Warms the Kidneys, strengthens Yang , warms the Spleen and alleviates pain. With Chao Rou Dou Kou , warms Kidney and Spleen Yang to Dispel Cold and helps Ren Shen and Bai Zhu strengthen the Spleen.

Astringes the Intestines, stops diarrhea, warms the Middle Jiao , moves Qi and alleviates pain. With Ren Shen, Bai Zhu and Rou Gui , for chronic diarrhea due to Spleen and Stomach Deficiency Cold. With He Zi , for chronic diarrhea and dysenteric disorders With Ren Shen, Zhi Ying Su Ke and Rou Gui for severe diarrhea with slippage of Qi .

Astringes the Intestines and stops diarrhea. With Zhi Ying Su Ke , binds the Intestines and stops diarrhea. With Ren Shen, Bai Zhu and Chao Rou Dou Kou, for long-term dysenteric disorders that have seriously injured the normal Qi leading to a prolapsed rectum. Moistens the Intestines, unblocks the bowels, alleviates pain and nourishes the Blood. With Bai Shao , regulates and harmonizes Qi and Blood and treats Blood Deficiency Heat.
Helps revive the Spleen, regulates Qi , prevents Stagnation and alleviates tenesmus. With Bai Zhu, for anorexia with epigastric and abdominal pain and distention.
Helps tonify the Middle Jiao and harmonizes. With Bai Shao, alleviates abdominal pain.

With Fu Ling, for lower body edema and dysuria.

Drains Dampness and strengthens the Spleen. With Zhi Fu Zi and Sheng Jiang, for edema due to Spleen and Kidney Yang Deficiency .
Spreads Lung Qi , warms the Stomach, disperses Cold, stops coughing and vomiting, and warms and dispels edema.
Preserves Yin , stops abdominal pain and relaxes spasms.

ingredients.actions: Restores Kidney and Spleen Yang . With Bai Zhu, for Spleen Yang Deficiency with a cold, painful abdomen, vomiting and watery diarrhea. With Bai Zhu and Fu Ling, for Kidney and Spleen Yang Deficiency with retention of pathogenic water with abdominal pain, which is worse with Cold, urinary difficulty, and deep aching and heaviness in the extremities. With Fu Ling, for lower body edema and dysuria.

Tonifies the Spleen and dries Dampness. With Fu Ling , strengthens the Spleen and promotes urination. With Sheng Jiang and Fu Ling , reinforces Earth to control Water to treat edema with Kidney Yang Deficiency .
Drains Dampness and strengthens the Spleen. With Zhi Fu Zi and Sheng Jiang, for edema due to Spleen and Kidney Yang Deficiency .
Spreads Lung Qi , warms the Stomach, disperses Cold, stops coughing and vomiting, and warms and dispels edema.
Preserves Yin , stops abdominal pain and relaxes spasms.

ingredients.actions: Enriches Kidney Yin and nourishes Jing and Blood. With Gou Qi Zi and Shan Zhu Yu , nourishes Liver Blood. With Gui Ban , for dizziness, weak and sore back, impotence, spermatorrhea and night sweats due to Kidney and Liver Yin Deficiency .
Benefits the Yin and the Spleen tonifies the Kidneys and astringes Jing . With S hu Di Huang and Shan Zhu Yu , for Kidney Deficiency with spermatorrhea and night sweats.
Nourishes Blood, tonifies the Liver and kidneys, nourishes Yin and benefits Jing .

Astringes Jing , tonifies Liver and Kidney Yin and strengthens Kidney Yang . With Shu Di Huang and Shan Yao, for urinary frequency (day or night), dizziness, tinnitus and lower back pain due to Kidney Deficiency.
Invigorates the channels and Blood, and treats atrophy and spasm of the lower extremities.
Tonifies Kidney Yang , tonifies Kidney and Liver Yin , and astringes Jing and urine.

Nourishes and tonifies Jing, Qi, and Blood. With Shu Di Huang , for Kidney Deficiency Cold with impotence and spermatorrhea (men), infertility and thin vaginal discharge (women) and physical retardation in children.
Nourishes Yin , anchors Yang , benefits the Kidneys strengthens bones and nourishes Blood. (Strongest Yin tonic).

syndromes: Liver and Kidney Yin Deficiency (especially essence and marrow)
Atrophy disorder ( Wei Syndrome) due to Liver and Kidney Deficiency
clinicalManifestations: Soreness and weakness in low back and legs
Thirst with a desire to drink
treats: Acute myelitis (inflammation of the spinal cord)
Infertility due to premature ovarian failure
contraindicationsAndInteractions: Use with caution and modify for those with Spleen and Stomach Deficiency.
Contraindicated for those with signs of Excess Heat.
This formula is not suited for long-term use.
notes: This is a stronger version of Zuo Gui Yin and is used in more severe cases.

ingredients.actions: Enriches Kidney Yin and nourishes Jing and Blood. With Gou Qi Zi and Shan Zhu Yu , nourishes Liver Blood. With Gui Ban , for dizziness, weak and sore back, impotence, spermatorrhea and night sweats due to Kidney and Liver Yin Deficiency .
Benefits the Yin and the Spleen tonifies the Kidneys and astringes Jing . With S hu Di Huang and Shan Zhu Yu , for Kidney Deficiency with spermatorrhea and night sweats.
Nourishes Blood, tonifies the Liver and kidneys, nourishes Yin and benefits Jing .

Astringes Jing , tonifies Liver and Kidney Yin and strengthens Kidney Yang . With Shu Di Huang and Shan Yao, for urinary frequency (day or night), dizziness, tinnitus and lower back pain due to Kidney Deficiency.
Invigorates the channels and Blood, and treats atrophy and spasm of the lower extremities.
Tonifies Kidney Yang , tonifies Kidney and Liver Yin , and astringes Jing and urine.

Nourishes and tonifies Jing, Qi, and Blood. With Shu Di Huang , for Kidney Deficiency Cold with impotence and spermatorrhea (men), infertility and thin vaginal discharge (women) and physical retardation in children.
Nourishes Yin , anchors Yang , benefits the Kidneys strengthens bones and nourishes Blood. (Strongest Yin tonic).

syndromes: Liver and Kidney Yin Deficiency (especially essence and marrow)
Atrophy disorder ( Wei Syndrome) due to Liver and Kidney Deficiency
clinicalManifestations: Soreness and weakness in low back and legs
Thirst with a desire to drink
treats: Acute myelitis (inflammation of the spinal cord)
Infertility due to premature ovarian failure

ingredients.actions: Enriches Kidney Yin and nourishes Jing and Blood. With Gou Qi Zi and Shan Zhu Yu , nourishes Liver Blood. With Gui Ban , for dizziness, weak and sore back, impotence, spermatorrhea and night sweats due to Kidney and Liver Yin Deficiency .
Benefits the Yin and the Spleen tonifies the Kidneys and astringes Jing . With S hu Di Huang and Shan Zhu Yu , for Kidney Deficiency with spermatorrhea and night sweats.
Nourishes Blood, tonifies the Liver and kidneys, nourishes Yin and benefits Jing .

Astringes Jing , tonifies Liver and Kidney Yin and strengthens Kidney Yang . With Shu Di Huang and Shan Yao, for urinary frequency (day or night), dizziness, tinnitus and lower back pain due to Kidney Deficiency.
Invigorates the channels and Blood, and treats atrophy and spasm of the lower extremities.
Tonifies Kidney Yang , tonifies Kidney and Liver Yin , and astringes Jing and urine.

Nourishes and tonifies Jing, Qi, and Blood. With Shu Di Huang , for Kidney Deficiency Cold with impotence and spermatorrhea (men), infertility and thin vaginal discharge (women) and physical retardation in children.

Invigorates the channels and Blood, and treats atrophy and spasm of the lower extremities.
Tonifies Kidney Yang , tonifies Kidney and Liver Yin , and astringes Jing and urine.

Nourishes and tonifies Jing, Qi, and Blood. With Shu Di Huang , for Kidney Deficiency Cold with impotence and spermatorrhea (men), infertility and thin vaginal discharge (women) and physical retardation in children.
Nourishes Yin , anchors Yang , benefits the Kidneys strengthens bones and nourishes Blood. (Strongest Yin tonic).

syndromes: Liver and Kidney Yin Deficiency (especially essence and marrow)
Atrophy disorder ( Wei Syndrome) due to Liver and Kidney Deficiency
clinicalManifestations: Soreness and weakness in low back and legs
Thirst with a desire to drink
treats: Acute myelitis (inflammation of the spinal cord)
Infertility due to premature ovarian failure
contraindicationsAndInteractions: Use with caution and modify for those with Spleen and Stomach Deficiency.
Contraindicated for those with signs of Excess Heat.
This formula is not suited for long-term use.
notes: This is a stronger version of Zuo Gui Yin and is used in more severe cases.
